title: AquaScan Prediction Schema
description: Schema for water prospecting predictions output by AquaScan models.

water_score.description: Probability/score that a favorable hydrogeological target exists (0-1).

evidence_score.description: Quality of the evidence backing the prediction (0-1).

abstain.description: If true, the prediction is NO CONCLUYENTE.

model_version.description: Version of the model that produced this prediction.

features_used.description: List of feature names used for this prediction.

water_depth_estimate_m.description: Estimated depth to water table in meters, if applicable.
